not_directly_comparable: Structural scores: each report uses its own candidate set, normalization, geography and analyst inputs.
Competitor counts: definitions, transparency and geographic scope differ.
Price bands: duration, food, group size, inclusions, take-home value and membership access differ.
Asking rents: samples mix gross, NNN, expense-excluded, shell, sublease and second-generation space.
Tourism: cities publish different boundaries and measures such as visitors, passengers, room nights and spending.
LODES jobs and jobs per resident: ZIP sizes, campuses, government centers and hybrid work distort results.
Food-service density: small downtown resident denominators can inflate per-capita figures.
ACS cultural proxies: demographics and language do not equal identity, product preference or purchase intent.
State import value: destination can be an importer or warehouse and is not local consumption.
Minimum wage: the floor excludes payroll load, scheduling rules, training, travel and market wages.
shared_validation_gates: Measure full-price conversion separately from free, partner and creator attendance.
Track contribution after tea, food, venue, permit, payment, labor, travel and acquisition costs.
Track take-home attachment and 30-, 60- and 90-day cohort reorder.
Repeat the same offer at least three times before treating launch novelty as demand.
Require delivery by a trained non-founder host before considering fixed occupancy.
Obtain site-specific permitted-use, build-out, utilities, accessibility, lease and total-occupancy diligence before any lease.
